data.name: Tibold
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word 'tibalt' which means 'brave in battle'. This name was popular among Germanic tribes and was adopted by early Christians as a name for their warriors.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace courage and strength in your spiritual journey.

in_hebrew.name: טבולד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'תבל' (thavl) meaning to flow, to go down, to flood. Tibold is a name that signifies strength in the Lord, as one who is strong in faith and trusts in God's protection.

in_greek.name: Θεοβόλδος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Θεος' (Theos) meaning God and 'βολδος' (boldos) meaning mighty. Tibold is a Greek name that conveys a sense of divine strength and power.

in_latin.name: Theobaldus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Theos' (God) and 'baldus' (servant). Tibold is a Latin name that reflects a servant of God, one who is devoted to serving God and following God's will.

in_english.name: Theobald
in_english.long_meaning: From the Old English 'Þeodebeald' (Þeodebealdan) meaning God's given one. Tibold is an English name that signifies a gift from God.

biblical_reference.note: Tibold is not a biblical name.

saint_reference.note: Theobald of Orléans (1130–1160), also known as Theobald III, was the Count of Champagne and Blois and Duke of Burgundy. He is venerated as a saint in the Roman Catholic Church.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Tibold" was popular among Germanic tribes and warriors, symbolizing strength, courage, and determination in battle. As early Christians adopted this name for their warriors, it became a reminder of their faith and the power of God in times of conflict.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Tibold" carries a deeper spiritual meaning beyond its literal translation. It reminds us that while we may face battles and challenges in life, our faith and trust in God should give us the courage and strength to overcome them. The name also serves as a reminder to be brave in our daily lives, standing up for what is right and fighting for justice and charity. In essence, "Tibold" is a name that calls us to be brave not only in battle but also in our daily lives, as we strive to live our faith and serve God with courage and determination.
